title: Unit-compatible locally constant description of the constant abelian sheaf
statement: Let X be a topological space and A an abelian group. Suppose abelian groups in the universe of A admit sheafification on the open site of X [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Let A_X be the sheafification of the constant presheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and let η be its sheafification unit. There exist additive equivalences e_U from A_X(U) to the locally constant maps from U to A [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-maps-presheaf], for every open U, such that e_V(s restricted to V)(x)=e_U(s)(x) for every inclusion V into U, every section s over U, and every x in V. Moreover e_U(η_U(a))(x)=a for every a in A and every x in U. Empty opens and unrelated space and coefficient universes are included.

theorem constantSheaf_locallyConstant_unit_comparison
    (X : TopCat.{u})
    [HasWeakSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    (A : Type v) [AddCommGroup A] :
    ∃ e : ∀ U : Opens X,
      AddEquiv (((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of A)).1.obj (op U)) (LocallyConstant U A),
      (∀ (U V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U) (s :
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of A)).1.obj (op U)) (x : V),
        e V (((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of A)).1.map (homOfLE hVU).op s) x =
            e U s ⟨x.1, hVU x.2⟩) ∧
      (∀ (U : Opens X) (a : A) (x : U),
        e U ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of A))).app (op U) a) x = a)
